text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Gentil-san! The hat for your birthday 
present will be finished knitting tonight!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No, it's what you took the trouble to 
tell me you wanted for your birthday, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I put so much care into making it for you. 
I made sure the floral corsage and yarn 
colors would match you perfectly...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Solid black, unmixed with anything else, 
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's lovely too, but... What I'd 
really like to give you is a hat as white 
as snow.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I also used some glitter thread for the 
corsage flower. I wanted to bring out both 
cuteness and elegance.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, my. That sounds like it will turn 
out wonderfully elegant—and sparkly.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes! And we put extra care into the 
ruffles on the brim! Splitting them into 
two layers to make them all soft and 
fluttery—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—And? Are you quite finished talking about 
hats?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No. There's still more. After all... this 
present is being made for someone strong, 
noble, and adorable."
